title: Strange Brew
tagline: Free beer. Cheap snacks. Hosers welcome.
about: Two hosers try to get free beer and stumble onto a plot at the Elsinore brewery.

Hold the toast.How to make it600g piece back bacon60g fine cornmeal2 tbsp vegetable oil2 onions, sliced3 tbsp wholegrain mustard2 tbsp maple syrup8 soft white bunsCut the bacon into thick slices and press both sides into the cornmeal.Fry in oil over medium heat, turning once, until golden and cooked through.Fry the onions in the same pan.Mix the mustard with the maple syrup. Split and toast the buns, spread with maple mustard and fill with bacon and onions.Doughnut shop honey glazed crullersFried choux crullers dipped in honey glazeHow to make it100g butter150g plain flour3 eggs1 L vegetable oil, for frying150g icing sugar2 tbsp honeyBring water, butter and a pinch of salt to the boil. Drain.Whisk the icing sugar, honey and water and dip the warm crullers.Hosehead's bacon-wrapped smokiesBeauty, eh.
